surviving_claim: Aligning every new logical primary generation to the 16-page mapping boundary removes mixed-generation mapping segments with at most 15 unused logical page ids per generation. In the tested real two-migration cycle, retired ownership is published from the real migration path, cleanup appends zero pages under fixed budgets, a reclaimed extent is reused only after a fixed 32-page scrub, and all 12 process-crash cases expose exact committed state with scan-free recovery.
claim_boundary: Single-writer process-crash experiment over fixed 64-bit logical segment and physical pointer namespaces. One retired-generation cleanup backlog is allowed at a time. No claim is made for hardware power-loss/torn-sector safety, arbitrary multi-writer/distributed correctness, metadata-node pruning, filesystem allocated-block deallocation, or production performance.
